APPROVED Li-O2 HIERARCHICAL ENGINEERING RECONCILIATION, item18, 2026-10-18. Wang,Deng,Yuan2020 DOI10.1016/j.jclepro.2020.121339, SI TablesS3/S4/S5/S16; Kanthal resistance-wire datasheet https://www.kanthal.com/products/datasheets/material-datasheets/wire/resistance-heating-wire-and-resistance-wire/nikrothal-80/. Adopt TableS3 detailed retained geometry: cell182.6kg, module hardware19.51, pack hardware43.67, oxygen tank55, BMS4,cooling29.07 =>333.85kg at63.5grosskWh. This conflicts with source headline321kg/267kg pack and with TableS5 gross material figures; do not mix those bases. Scalable cell/module/pack hardware=245.78kg; fixed-per-reference auxiliary hardware=88.07kg. Listed component masses, not proportional normalization of contradictory gross LCI tables, define this engineering reference. Known cell ingredients total182.59kg;0.01kg unspecified cathode catalyst remains a documented composition gap, not zero-metal proof. The sourceS4 fluoropolymer binder is not substituted for the unidentified S3 catalyst; binder quantity/fate is also unresolved, and that old process input is disabled in this reference. Electrolyte total59.11kg is split by inheritedS4 salt:solvent ratio.016:.308; LiClO4 process is the inherited salt provider, and ethylene-glycol dimethyl ether remains an explicitly imperfect TEGDME solvent proxy. Lithium protective film/pouch/separator process recipes remain inherited and unvalidated. Collector feed is1kg metal/kg foil at100percent reference retention; matching rolling and restored facility proxy are preserved. Terminal metal fractions are2.44kgAl/10.5kg and8.06kgCu/10.5kg, with matching working services; old overlapping gross feed and implied manufacturing scrap are disabled under the explicit100percent retention reference. Module and pack known material inputs followS3, with no new gross-yield claim. Module monitor.67kg is counted once; BMS4kg is assigned to central protection only using4/4.518 of the separate engineering central-control package. This functional repartition is an assumption, not a source breakdown. Cooling uses7kg Al plus22.07kg pureEG reference (alternative50/50 coolant is a sensitivity); thermal duty, pump/hoses remain gaps. Heater.2kg uses an idealized binary80Ni/20Cr resistance-alloy reference, consistent with a NiCr class but not a complete measured battery heater/Nikrothal composition; electronic/heater construction is unresolved. Preserve historical source-specific S16 recycling coefficients without new recovery credits. Capacity purchases245.78/63.5kg scalable hardware plus one auxiliary lifecycle unit per63.5kWh. Its negative waste equals scalable mass; auxiliary unit carries its own88.07kg waste. Future density factors scale hardware and its waste together; fixed auxiliary manufacture/treatment stay paired. Existing relative density learning is retained as an engineering ratio; absolute cell energy63.5/182.6=.347754655kWh/kg and fixed recipe are not a validated future design. Original full-battery market remains manufacturing-only at333.85kg component-sum basis; capacity uses the separately named hardware market. Vehicle energy/lifetime allocation is unchanged. Source contradictions, catalyst, solvent, future structure and recovery performance remain explicit gaps.
PREVIOUS NOTES (retained as history; the correction above takes precedence):
APPROVED LI-O2 RAIL-FREIGHT SOURCE-TRANSCRIPTION CORRECTION, 2026-10-17. Wang, Deng and Yuan (2020), Journal of Cleaner Production 264, 121339, DOI 10.1016/j.jclepro.2020.121339, original supplementary DOCX Table S14 Life cycle inventory of 1 kg module packaging, row Transport_freght_rail: 2 tkm per 1 kg component. Correct the existing 0.2 ton kilometer/kg to 2 ton kilometer/kg: the old coefficient was one tenth of the published value. One tkm is one metric tonne-kilometre. At 1 kg transported mass, the source coefficient is equivalent to 2000 km, compared with 200 km for the old value; these are dimensional equivalents, not independently verified actual routes. Retain the existing regional freight train market, reference product, location and unit. The source supplier was RER rail transport; its historical transport assumption, the adaptation to the current supplier, actual modern distances, freight mix and future logistics are not validated by this repair. All direct material/process inputs, other transport, reference output, component purchases and lifetime equipment allocations are retained. Do not renormalize component masses or infer a quantified system-metal effect; source assembly mass/yield and battery normalization issues remain separate. Source: https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S095965262031386X-mmc2.docx .
PREVIOUS SOURCE NOTES:
The module and pack packagings are modelled based on the results from BatPaC method. The aluminum and copper films are produced by the sheet rolling with a 98.2% material efficiency. As for the steel film, cold rolling is modelled with 99% material efficiency (Green, 2007). Source: Originally from Wang, F., Deng, Y., & Yuan, C. (2020). Life cycle assessment of lithium oxygen battery for electric vehicles. Journal of Cleaner Production, 264, 121339. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jclepro.2020.121339 Local Li-O2 module copper-wire feed completion, 2026-10-17 (approved). Wang, Deng and Yuan (2020), DOI 10.1016/j.jclepro.2020.121339, supplementary Table S14: Life cycle inventory of 1 kg module packaging, https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S095965262031386X-mmc2.docx. The source labels Copper wire = 115 g but links it only to RER copper wire drawing. Wire drawing is a processing service excluding the main metal feed; the existing native RER recipe buys 0.039644 kg cathode copper per kg service to replace processing losses. Complete the intended 115/1000 = 0.115 kg nominal copper-wire input by adding 0.115 kg market for copper, cathode, GLO, per kg declared module packaging. Retain the existing 0.115 kg wire-drawing service, which supplies its own replacement-loss metal. The selected immediate wire path therefore buys 0.115 + 0.115*0.039644 = 0.11955906 kg gross cathode feed per kg module packaging, before wider supply-chain feedback; this is not the retained wire mass or a full-system refined-copper result. No extra 98.2% rolling-efficiency factor is applied to the wire. This is an approved physical completion of the source service-only mapping, not an extra material row explicitly listed in the original S14. Use the cathode market as a metal-stock proxy with its existing mix; source-specific purity, primary/secondary content and future shares remain unresolved. Source output normalization, other component material/process identities, unreported fabrication outflows and whole battery mass basis remain open. Retain all other quantities, output and processing services; no blanket yield or packaging-mass renormalization. Source DOCX SHA256: 760c98ff6240558bf1bdb2df42039f678768b627667f2db437d754bf4c4ec52a.

Preserve the monitor mass, module output, every other exchange amount/formula, consumer coefficients and retirement quantities. Retain original paired ecoinvent 3.9 source declarations. Other module-packaging recipe differences remain outside this alignment. Historical source text follows unchanged.
